scope: Book-Ceremony runbook gap G3 / OWNER Vorlage V4: orthogonality standard for sparse D1 sleeves supplementing the Vault Q15 hard rule |r|<0.5 on Q10 equity curves.
authority: Estimator + decision-rule SHAPE adopted; all gate thresholds are ROT and left to OWNER. No invented thresholds.

layer_a_primary_certifier.name: ZK-SBB (Zeros-Kept daily-return Pearson + stationary block-bootstrap CI)
layer_a_primary_certifier.estimand: daily-return correlation of the two equity curves = the Q15 hard-rule object
layer_a_primary_certifier.window: exogenous Mon-Fri business-day grid over the COMMON-SUPPORT intersection window [max(first_a,first_b)..min(last_a,last_b)]; non-trade days kept as real zeros
layer_a_primary_certifier.uncertainty: stationary block bootstrap (Politis-Romano 1994); block length auto (Politis-White 2004 / PPW 2009), b=max(b_x,b_y,b_xy); report |r|_upper=max(|r_lo|,|r_hi|)
layer_a_primary_certifier.verdict: CERTIFY_A iff bootstrap 95% CI subset (-0.5,+0.5) [= build_book_ftmo.py:70 default 0.50]; else ABSTAIN (fail-closed)

layer_b_supplementary_flag.name: COS (trade-level open-position co-occupancy + exact circular-shift null)
layer_b_supplementary_flag.role: FLAG only, not a certifier (surrogate estimand: time-in-market != return co-movement)
layer_b_supplementary_flag.occupancy: D_s = union over trades of [entry_day..exit_day] inclusive; entry_time schema portfolio_common.py:55

estimators.null: exact all-T circular shift via FFT; p_upper=#{delta:O(delta)>=O}/T >= 1/T (Phipson-Smyth 2010)

layer_b_supplementary_flag.flag: FLAG_B iff BH-adjusted p_upper<=alpha AND lambda>lambda* AND (where defined) Psi indicates same-direction stacking
layer_b_supplementary_flag.untestable: UNTESTABLE_SATURATION when a sleeve occupies large ring fraction -> route to Layer A

adopted_method.above_60_coactive_days: incumbent Pearson |r|<0.5 on zeros-kept common-support window is decisive; Layer B advisory
adopted_method.separation_of_concerns: cross-symbol economic correlation, signal-family redundancy, tail co-crash remain with select_under_aggregate_control (build_book_ftmo.py:181) + family<=3/symbol<=2 caps, never this screen

option_a.label: status quo sparse Pearson as screening prior
option_a.consequence: portfolio_correlation.py returns None for 0/46 book-relevant pairs (dossier 3c); |r|<0.5 control fail-OPEN by omission

option_b.label: require fresh Q14-terminal streams with >=60-day overlap before any orthogonality claim (dossier 3c rec)
option_b.consequence: gold standard but structurally UNSATISFIABLE for this cadence (activity criterion yields ~2 expected co-active exit days, never 60); permanently defers the control
option_b.verdict: keep as standing gold standard, cannot be the only control

option_c.label: adopt two-layer sparse-D1 standard; Pearson |r|<0.5 decisive above 60 co-active exit-days

vorlage_v4.recommendation: Option (c), with (b) as the standing gold standard it supplements not replaces. Ratify the METHOD now (GRUEN/GELB); defer numeric thresholds (ROT) to first SHA-frozen Q14-terminal calibration cohort.
vorlage_v4.cost_of_wait: LOW today (binding gate is the 25-floor: qualified_pairs=5 allowed=false; no book buildable). Front-loaded: leaving V4 at (a)/(b) means the control is still fail-open-by-omission / unsatisfiable when census reaches 25, stalling Q15 then. Ratifying the method now costs nothing today and removes that future stall.

portfolio_correlation_py_changes_design_.change: replace value=None silent drop with structured fail-closed verdict {CERTIFY_ORTHOGONAL|REVIEW|ABSTAIN|UNTESTABLE}
remove both-nonzero subset; compute Layer A on Mon-Fri intersection-window zeros-kept vectors
add occupancy series from entry_time..time for Layer B; keep to_daily_pnl for Layer A
parameterize alpha,lambda*,caution band,B,seed as WORKING_DEFAULT_OPEN_OWNER_ITEM config

refutation_criteria: 1 no-discrimination: same-EA-two-symbols positive control must FLAG on Layer B (else refuted)
2 benign-reparam: verdict sign must be invariant to calendar-vs-weekday ring, +-1 day occupancy, granularity (weekday rerun NOT yet run)
3 occupancy saturation: high-occupancy sleeves must be UNTESTABLE_SATURATION -> Layer A (else refuted if book admitted on saturation artifacts)
4 P&L/CI cross-check: a Layer-B pass with strongly same-signed shared-day P&L, or a Layer-A CERTIFY realizing |r|>=0.5 OOS on SHA-bound streams, refutes that pair -> abstain
5 Layer-A honesty controls: rotation negative control must not be anti-conservative; identity must reject; partial-clone power curve must be monotone rising

minimum_data.layer_a: self-calibrating; CI must clear +-0.5; starvation -> wide CI -> ABSTAIN. Reported adequacy ~m>=8-12 co-active days for near-zero pairs; heavy-tailed pairs stay wide even at m=50 (decision rides CI not day count).
minimum_data.layer_b_power_boundary_proposal_measured: E_ab>=5 AND n_a,n_b>=30 occupancy days = testable at lambda>=1.5 p<0.05; underpowered only for 1537/XAGUSD (22 trades)
minimum_data.activity_criterion_tie_in: a sleeve passing >=10 entry-days/scored-year accumulates ~150-600 occupancy days -> E_ab~7.5>=5 (Layer-B testable) while expected co-active EXIT days ~2 (Pearson-on-exit structurally empty). The ratified criterion guarantees co-activity testability while leaving the 60-exit-day floor unreachable.

statistical_validity_lens.reason: ZK-SBB keeps the Q15 estimand identical and fixes two confirmed defects (both-nonzero selection bias; union-window fabricated zeros); COS's exact null is on a surrogate whose gap is exhibited by its own Lambda=8.61 at r~0.001

goodhart_lens.reason: COS position-open observable is immune to exit-timing games and catches same-EA/two-symbol redundancy daily-r certifies orthogonal; ZK-SBB inherits exit-day P&L bucketing so held-but-unexited co-exposure reads as flat

judge_synthesis.resolution: Adopt both: ZK-SBB primary certifier on the true Q15 object with fail-closed abstain; COS mandatory supplementary flag for co-timing/family redundancy that daily-r is blind to. Both proposals self-frame as supplementing |r|<0.5 and the separate family/tail caps.

limitations: screening prior not book-grade: <=50 co-active days, 6/9 audited streams superseded, qualified streams in mutable Common\Files export
Layer A construct gap: daily-r blind to family redundancy (same-EA r~0.004) and tail co-crash -> family<=3/symbol<=2 + tail caps stay separate
Layer B construct gap: co-occupancy is a surrogate for drawdown-clustering (flag not certifier)
cross-symbol sign undefined without FX/asset factor model; signed layer same-instrument only
thresholds are ROT/OWNER; proposed defaults not set here
NOT yet run: weekday-vs-calendar ring robustness rerun + in-tree re-execution of both estimators (prerequisites before treated as measured evidence)
